song.title: Goodnight Phone
song.style: English, dreamy lullaby pop with music box and soft synth pads, brightening into a sunny chorus with handclaps, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 98 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Three a.m. and wide awake
Glowing like a midnight lake
Thumb is tired, eyes are sore
Shuffled down the kitchen floor

[Chorus]
Goodnight phone, on the fridge you go
Little green bed where the pings can't grow
Goodnight phone, sleep tight, don't call
I'll see you after I see it all

[Verse]
Slept like moss upon a stone
Dreamt of gardens, not my phone
Woke up early, sun was gold
Pancakes warm and coffee bold

[Chorus]
Good morning world, you were here all along
Birds on the sill singing my song
Good morning world, the day is new
Phone's still asleep and I'm with you

shots.prompt: {moss} lies wide awake in bed at night with huge round eyes, a cold blue glow flickering on his face. Static medium shot. Dark blue night light.
{moss} shuffles down a dark hallway in his boots, yawning, toward the soft light of the kitchen. The camera follows from behind. Dim blue light.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door late at night, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Soft light from the open fridge falls across it. Static close-up, the camera eases back as the hand pulls away.
{moss} climbs back into bed, pulls the quilt up to his mustache and falls asleep instantly, a little smile on his face. Static medium shot. Soft moonlight.
{moss} sleeps peacefully as tiny glowing flowers bloom around his pillow. Slow push in. Soft dreamy blue and gold light.
{moss} wakes as a beam of golden sunrise hits his face, and stretches his arms wide with a huge yawn. Static medium shot. Warm golden morning light.
{moss} flips a pancake high out of a pan in a sunny kitchen and catches it. Static medium shot. Bright warm morning light.
{moss} opens a kitchen window and two little birds land on the sill, chirping at him. The camera pushes in gently. Fresh morning light.
{moss} sits on his front doorstep sipping coffee from a big mug, watching the sun rise over the rooftops. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss tucked his phone into its Hibernator at 3am and slept like moss on a stone. Pancakes at sunrise.
